status: Retrospective reanalysis; plan fixed before this run, after previous results were viewed. Not preregistered or independently confirmatory.

design.allocation: Randomized, user report; allocation procedure unavailable
design.sample_size: 10 per group fixed in advance, user report

selection.sensitivity: existing condition-by-original-trial MT mean +/- 1.5 sample SD; shared removal for all metrics

estimand_direction: C2 minus C3; change is late minus early

primary.test: 2x2 mixed ANOVA interaction; exactly pooled-variance independent t on participant changes, F=t^2

secondary.tests: TPe and ER change differences (2), late condition difference and within-C2/within-C3 change for MT/TPe/ER (9)

exploratory.tests: MT/TPe: early Welch, early/late slope Welch, log late detrended residual SD Welch, Brown-Forsythe late means and changes (12); ER early difference (1); joint centered GAMM shape differences MT/TPe/ER (3); ER early/late mean probability slope difference (2)

inference.tails: two-sided except nonnegative omnibus F/chi-square statistics
inference.ci_multiplicity: individual unadjusted confidence intervals unless explicitly simultaneous
inference.late_continuous_test: pooled late-specific participant variance; not error pooled across periods
inference.within_continuous_test: one-factor two-level RMANOVA, paired t squared
inference.slope: OLS against original N within each window; participant slope is independent unit
inference.residual_sd: sample SD (ddof=1) of OLS residuals within late window; zero makes log-SD test unavailable, no epsilon
inference.missing: available valid trials for participant mean; paired analyses need both windows; no imputation or outcome-driven participant threshold; report missingness

er_glmm.estimation: lme4 glmer, Laplace, independent random intercept and time slope; singularity reported without p-based model replacement
er_glmm.estimand: population-marginal ER integrated over normally distributed participant random effects, contrast in percentage points; not logistic interaction
er_glmm.uncertainty: 1999 parametric participant-level model bootstraps, both random effects and outcomes regenerated; bootstrap SE normal Wald test/CI, percentile CI also retained; approximate with 20 participants

gamm.family: Gaussian identity for MT/TPe, binomial logit for ER
gamm.autocorrelation: rho estimated once from adjacent Pearson residuals of rho=0 model within participant and rest block; clipped to [-0.95,0.95]; AR.start at participant changes, rest breaks and missing N gaps; no iterative model selection
gamm.binomial_ar_caveat: working-residual AR correction is a GEE approximation, not exact serial binomial likelihood
gamm.shape_test: joint approximate Wald chi-square for condition contrast centered over N=1..400, including condition-by-block and smooth difference; eigenspace tolerance 1e-8; penalized covariance approximation, exploratory only
gamm.shape_scale: MT/TPe response, ER logit; probability curves also shown
gamm.bands: 95% simultaneous bands across 400 N per metric from 10000 Gaussian coefficient draws; not simultaneous across metrics
gamm.er_slopes: (population-typical fixed-curve probability at window end minus start)/99; delta-method difference in percentage points/trial
gamm.diagnostics: convergence, basis k diagnostic, residual lag1, random effects, dispersion; no outcome-based tuning

robustness.primary: Welch change test; exact participant-label permutation of mean change difference; stratified participant bootstrap CI (9999); leave-one-participant-out estimates
robustness.outliers: repeat predeclared analyses under +/-1.5SD; sensitivity cannot replace primary; adjustment within same families separately, not additional confirmation
robustness.permutation_caveat: conditional on exchangeability under randomized allocation; exact allocation restrictions were not supplied
